mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of monetary policy accommodation and triggers positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential housing starts above 1.2 million units per month signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand for durable goods, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where HOUST exceeds 1.2 million for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 105.0 index level over two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of central bank intervention and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in instances where INDPRO falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both personal consumption expenditures (PAYEMS) and residential investment (HOUST) signals broad-based demand strength, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS and HOUST are rising simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% over three consecutive months, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressures that trigger a hawkish monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months and FEDFUNDS is stable or rising (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls signals a strong labor market recovery, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 440,000 million dollars, combined with a decline in industrial production, signals weakening aggregate demand, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS falls below 440,000 and INDPRO is below 106.0 (t-test p > 0.05).
